reply.content:
Here's how to recover your account:

1. On the login page, click **"Forgot password"** and enter the email address linked to your account.
2. You'll get a reset link by email — usually within a couple of minutes. If it doesn't arrive, check your spam/junk folder.
3. Open the link and set a new password.

A couple of things to note:
- If you've changed your phone number or email recently, the reset link will go to the email we have on file. If you no longer have access to that email, let me know and I can open a ticket for our human support team to verify your identity.
- For security, email and password changes must be done through Account Settings with verification, so I can't reset them directly from here.

Would you like me to open a support ticket in case the reset email doesn't come through?
